applied_optimizations.name: Increase BLOCK_N in grouped decode attention
applied_optimizations.description: Increased BLOCK_N from 32 to 64 for HIP with Lk < 256 (Qwen3-VL has Lk=128). Added intermediate tier: Lk >= 256 uses BLOCK_N=32.

applied_optimizations.name: Increase waves_per_eu and num_stages for HIP
applied_optimizations.description: Changed waves_per_eu from 1 to 2, and num_stages from 1 to 2 for HIP in _decode_grouped_att_m_fwd. This improves GPU occupancy and instruction-level parallelism on MI355X.
